title: A training week in Denver, weight in pounds: does it cook and weigh as the US does?
message: Could you plan my meals for next week, {Mon} to {Sun}?
Tue: 1h10 run with 5 x 5 min at threshold
Thu: 50 min easy run with 6 strides
I weigh 141 lb and live in Denver, Colorado. No restrictions. The fridge is empty.
That's everything — please go ahead and make the plan.

judge.question: Is every quantity on the shopping list one a shopper in the United States could buy as written, without converting it from another measurement system first?
